Version %1$s:
  • Added an optional carousel layout for posts with multiple media items, configurable globally or per timeline.
  • Added X Discover topic timelines and automatic link previews for Bluesky posts.
  • Gallery mode now supports long-press or right-click post actions on Android, iOS, macOS, and Desktop.
  • Improved feed and media reliability, including X notifications, Mastodon Discover pagination, repost ordering, Nostr profiles, RSS video embeds, and iOS Gallery sizing.
